inputs.userGoal: Add Azure service deployment Bicep script for the Blob Storage growth monitor.
subGoals: Use .NET 10 on Azure Functions Flex Consumption.
Use private networking for Function dependencies and managed identity with RBAC.
Deploy an HTTP-trigger Logic App shell; configure its email action manually.
insightsApplied: insight-existing-monitored-storage: the monitored storage account is referenced and receives only additive RBAC integration.

reasoning.whyChosen: Creates an isolated lifecycle boundary for the monitoring workload.
alternativesConsidered: Deploy into an existing resource group

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides a dedicated Flex integration subnet and a separate private endpoint subnet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private networking increases deployment and DNS complexity.

references.title: Azure Functions Flex Consumption virtual networking

reasoning.whyChosen: Hosts Functions runtime state, deployment packages, and the monitor history table with shared-key access disabled.
alternativesConsidered: Separate host and history storage accounts
reasoning.tradeoffs: A single account reduces cost and complexity but shares one failure domain.

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides Function exception, dependency, and execution telemetry.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Public ingestion remains enabled because an Azure Monitor Private Link Scope is outside this initial template.

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides the HTTP endpoint expected by the Function while leaving provider-specific email authentication for manual configuration.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The generated workflow acknowledges alerts but does not send email until an action is added.

reasoning.whyChosen: Flex Consumption supports .NET 10, managed-identity deployment storage, and VNet integration.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The timer workload is single-region and does not use deployment slots.

references.title: Flex Consumption managed identity Bicep quickstart

reasoning.whyChosen: This is the existing account whose container metric is queried.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Its network and metric configuration remain outside this additive deployment.

overallReasoning.summary: Deploy a private-networked Flex Consumption Function with passwordless storage access and centralized telemetry, while referencing the monitored account without recreating it.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: The Consumption Logic App trigger and Azure Monitor ingestion remain public service endpoints. The Logic App email action must be configured after deployment.

plan.validation: All dependencies resolve; Flex uses a dedicated /27 Microsoft.App/environments subnet, private endpoints use a separate subnet, StorageV2 is used for Functions, and the existing monitored account is referenced only.
